SEARCH ACTION (scripts/operator/actions/v3-system-search-f1.sh; design 8.5, table row 7). Retarget from opt1 to the pinned current PUBLISHED parallel_v1: TARGET_GENERATION_KEY ratings_v4_prod_p4_parallel_v1, TARGET_GENERATION_ID cfc25d36-3bc7-4011-a465-d6460eaaf826, TARGET_PUBLICATION_SEQUENCE 1 (both read from the step 0 receipt at build time into constants, as the complete action does), TARGET_CANONICAL_GENERATION/sequence as today; require_generation checks key AND UUID AND PUBLISHED AND current pointer AND publication sequence. Replace the single 006 pin with pins for 010_v3_system_search_body_type_counts.sql AND 015_v3_derived_product_publication.sql (checkout sha256 of each equals a constant in the script AND equals the live v3_meta.schema_migration ledger hash; refuse otherwise; keep 006 pinned too since the lifecycle it extends is still applied). Identity first: source scripts/operator/lib/f2d_operator_identity.sh and require_f2d_operator_code_identity before require_target, in every mode. Worker name edfinder-v3-system-search-p4-parallel-v1; the builder command becomes --generation-key ratings_v4_prod_p4_parallel_v1 --follow --poll-seconds 5; STATE_ROOT stays ${HOME}/.local/state/ed-finder/v3-system-search. start: after the existing checks and BEFORE launching the worker, (1) run the capacity gate: "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/operator/actions/v3-finder-capacity-gate.sh" run "$REPO_ROOT" "$SOURCE_SHA" with F2D_OPERATOR_CODE_SHA256_ATTESTED exported, capture its stdout to "$STATE_ROOT/capacity-gate-receipt.json" and refuse (exit 64, message naming the gate's exit code) unless it exited 0 and the envelope's status is passed; (2) write the sealed build-start receipt at "$STATE_ROOT/build-start-receipt.json" with relation_total_bytes_at_start = pg_total_relation_size('v3_derived.system_search') read now through db_query, the pinned generation UUID, product_code system_search, manifest_sha256 = the Search product manifest sha256 for this generation and checkout (compute it in-container through scripts/v3_system_search.py product_manifest -- add a tiny --print-manifest-sha256 mode to the builder if needed and name it; the Search registration path must then be given --expected-manifest-sha256 <that value> so registration refuses on any difference), started_at, f2d_operator_code_sha256 -- a start that finds an existing build-start receipt for the same product/generation/manifest keeps it (resume) and a receipt for a different manifest refuses; (3) launch the worker as today. status: unchanged in spirit (read-only), plus print the gate receipt path/seal and the build-start receipt. New mode finalize (design 8.5 "last action after the final insert"): identity first; require_target; require_generation; refuse unless the worker container has exited 0 and v3_meta.derived_product for the pinned generation and system_search is READY with validation_receipt->>'status' = 'VERIFIED' and no later chunk receipt is being written (worker not running); read final_insert_at = max(completed_at) FROM v3_derived.search_build_chunk for the generation; then run VACUUM (ANALYZE) v3_derived.system_search through a new db_maintenance function (docker exec psql as DATABASE_USER with ON_ERROR_STOP, NO surrounding BEGIN -- VACUUM cannot run in a transaction block; this is the only non-SELECT statement any F2d action issues and the test asserts exactly that), bounded by timeout 7200; then read pg_stat_user_tables.last_vacuum and last_analyze for v3_derived.system_search, refuse unless both postdate final_insert_at, and write the sealed receipt "$STATE_ROOT/build-final-receipt.json" {schema_version ed-finder/v3-build-final-receipt/v1, product_code, derived_generation_id, manifest_sha256, final_insert_at, last_vacuum, last_analyze, row_count = count of sealed chunk receipts and sum(systems), lifecycle_state, validation_status, f2d_operator_code_sha256} and print it; finalize is idempotent (a second call re-reads and re-verifies without a second VACUUM when last_vacuum already postdates final_insert_at -- say so in the receipt). The publish action (part D) refuses unless this receipt exists and its timestamps verify.

ARCHETYPE ACTION (scripts/operator/actions/v3-system-archetype.sh; design 8.5, table row 8; modelled on the retargeted Search action). start/status/finalize with the same constants, identity-first order, pins for 011_v3_system_archetype.sql AND 015 (checkout hash constant + live ledger), worker edfinder-v3-system-archetype-p4-parallel-v1, OPERATION_LABEL ed-finder.operation=v3-system-archetype, STATE_ROOT ${HOME}/.local/state/ed-finder/v3-system-archetype, TARGET_CPUS 8 / TARGET_MEMORY 32g as F1, --read-only root filesystem with --tmpfs /tmp as the complete worker. start additionally: refuses unless the Search product on the pinned generation is READY/VERIFIED and its build-final receipt exists (Search must be built first -- the builder also requires it); requires the capacity gate to pass and stores its receipt as above; computes the expected manifest check -- the builder is launched with --expected-manifest-sha256 <expected_product_manifest_sha256 from the committed complete receipt at f2d_evidence.COMPLETE_RECEIPT, validated with validate_complete_receipt on the host with python3.14 before launch> so registration refuses rather than registering a manifest the capacity gate did not test; the build-start receipt's manifest_sha256 is that same value; the in-container command runs the image-model check (sha256 of /app/shared_contracts/v3_system_archetype_model.py equals the checkout's, refuse otherwise -- reuse require_image_model_match from scripts/v3_archetype_calibration_complete.py or a one-line sha256 comparison in the shell preamble) and then scripts/v3_system_archetype.py --generation-key ratings_v4_prod_p4_parallel_v1 --follow --poll-seconds 5 --expected-manifest-sha256 <value>; the start proof is at least one archetype_build_chunk receipt within 60 s as F1 proves a Search chunk. finalize: like Search's but for v3_derived.system_archetype, archetype_build_chunk, and it first runs the reviewed validation route scripts/v3_system_archetype.py --generation-key ... --validate --expected-manifest-sha256 <value> inside a fresh short-lived container (the --validate path reaches READY/VERIFIED; refuse unless the product then reads READY with validation_receipt status VERIFIED and the wide-row count equals the generation's expected_systems), then VACUUM (ANALYZE) v3_derived.system_archetype, timestamps, sealed build-final receipt.
